summary: Frontend-only REGRESSION check after the src/lib/firebase.js clean() sanitizer change, on https://precious-lookbook.preview.emergentagent.com. (1) ADMIN: /admin/login rendered, logged in as admin@bagmarjewellers.com, admin-dashboard appeared, and seed-card was polled every 100ms for the entire load window plus 2s after — NEVER appeared. Exactly 52 product-row-* rows rendered; stat cards read 52 Pieces / 15 Live Offers / 9 Featured / 7 Categories; gold rates (7,245 / 7,905) and 3 hero slides all populated from live Firestore. (2) CONSOLE: zero errors, zero pageerrors, zero Firebase/Firestore messages on both admin and public routes (only 2 benign console messages total). (3) PUBLIC: '/' loads, featured-section visible with 9 featured-card-* products, 7 category-tile-*, gold-rate ticker live; clicking a category tile navigated to /collections/bracelets which rendered 8 product-card-* items — CatalogueContext Firestore listeners intact. CONCLUSION: the clean() sanitizer did NOT break Firebase init or reads in preview; no regression found. No writes/deletes/seed-import performed.
critical_code_review_comments: clean() uses .replace(/\s+/g,'') which strips ALL internal whitespace — safe for the 6 Firebase config values (none legitimately contain spaces) but do not reuse this helper for user-facing strings.
clean()'s quote strip /^['"]|['"]$/ removes only one quote per end; a doubly-quoted value ('"x"') would survive. Minor, non-blocking.
Carried over from iteration 3 and still open: AdminDashboard.jsx load() error path shows a toast but no Retry affordance, and the file is >600 lines and should be split.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only regression run, no writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testid naming note: public product cards on the homepage featured rail are 'featured-card-{id}' (NOT 'product-card-{id}'); 'product-card-{id}' is used on category/collection pages. Admin rows are 'product-row-{id}' (52 of them). Live production Firestore — never click seed-import-btn or delete/create.
rca_of_the_issue: Original live failure was a trailing newline in REACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID on Vercel producing projects/bagmar-jewellers%0A in the Firestore URL. The clean() sanitizer in firebase.js normalizes this; preview env values were already clean, and this run confirms the sanitizer is a no-op there (52 products read, no seed-card, no console errors).
